sites.note: gameapplication.cpp checksum gate: test eax,eax -> xor eax,eax, forcing the setcc result (achievements allowed) true. Register byte wildcarded; anchored to the func that logs 'Active Mod Count:' so only the real gate matches.
Legacy-preserving: eu4application.cpp + checksum-helper sites (test eax,eax; sete bl; call). Both patched test->xor, matching the original tool's behavior.
EU5 1.4.7: setter of the 'not using another player's savegame' flag (+0x130 of the achievement manager). movzx ebx,byte[rdx] -> mov bl,1; nop.

EU5 1.4.7: CanGetAchievements flag chain (cmp [m+0x134],0; jne eligible; cmp [m+0x139],1 ...). jne -> jmp makes every copy return eligible: in-game UI + three achievement-manager copies. Successor of the original can_get_achievements site.
EU5 1.4.7: achievement update skips evaluation unless eligible (cmp [rsi+0x134],0; je check). Immediate 0 -> 0xFF so the je is never taken and achievements are always evaluated.
EU5 1.4.7: UI CanGetAchievements / GameWouldGetAchievements (menu, lobby). mov eax,1; ret.
